D10Digital

CV to MIDI

The rack plays MIDI gear

Turns control voltages into MIDI: a sequencer in the rack plays a MIDI synth, and LFOs and envelopes control its parameters.

  • Four channels, each with CV and gate
  • Notes or controllers per channel
  • Set up with a browser-based configurator
Width8 HP · 40.4 mm
Height3 U · 128.5 mm
Jacks9
Switches and buttons4
